description: Explain the column names used in WHO tuberculosis data — what e_inc_100k, c_newinc, e_mort_num or budget_cpp_mdr actually mean, which dataset each belongs to, and its definition. Use to interpret a WHO TB field before reporting a number, or to find which variable answers a question.

query.description: A variable name ("e_inc_100k") or words from its definition ("incidence"). Omit to list all.

name: who_tb_dictionary
